description: This file defines an internal interface IPropertyDescription and a class PropertyDescription within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. The class models property metadata, including type information, symbol references, and serialization attributes, for code generation purposes.

classes.name: IPropertyDescription
classes.description: An internal interface extending IMemberDescription, representing property metadata.

classes.name: PropertyDescription
classes.description: A class implementing IPropertyDescription, encapsulating property details such as type, symbol, and serialization info for code generation.

methods.name: PropertyDescription
